# Lightweight fallback monthly pulse for Post-1453 Exile Revival (BYZ / human TRE / human FEO).
# Deduplicated per country per month via oe_l7_ex_ran_m; rebel-guarded per fx17_rebel_guard.py.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_l7_exile_fallback_pulse } }

oe_l7_exile_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        current_year >= 1453
        current_year <= 1535
        NOT = { var:oe_l7_ex_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
        OR = {
            AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
            tag = TRE
            tag = FEO
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_l7_ex_monthly = yes }
    }
}
